title: feat: X-Teacher-ID header — get_current_teacher + require_teacher dependencies
feat: X-Teacher-ID header — get_current_teacher + require_teacher dependencies
resolution: Added get_current_teacher and require_teacher to deps.py. get_current_teacher reads X-Teacher-ID header (optional), validates UUID format, looks up Teacher filtered by current client_id, raises 404 if not found. require_teacher wraps it and raises 422 if header absent. feat: require X-Teacher-ID on lesson plan generation; store teacher_id on lesson_plans

title: refactor: teachers list — table with server-side search + pagination
refactor: teachers list — table with server-side search + pagination
resolution: Backend: added optional `search` query param to GET /api/v1/teachers. list_teachers service now accepts search: str | None and applies ILIKE filter on name OR email when provided. Frontend: replaced card/list layout with a proper <table> (columns: Name, Email, Phone, School, Registered). Added debounced search input (400ms) above the table that fires a new request to /api/v1/teachers?search=...&limit=10&offset=0, resetting to page 1. Loading state shows animated pulse row spanning all columns. Empty state message is context-aware (shows search term when active). Pagination is Previous/Next with page N of M counter, matching existing lesson-plans pattern. Build passes, 28/28 non-auth tests pass.

title: redesign: lesson-plans page — teacher selector gating + teacher_id backend filter
redesign: lesson-plans page — teacher selector gating + teacher_id backend filter
resolution: Backend: added optional teacher_id UUID query param to GET /api/v1/lesson-plans router; list_lesson_plans service now accepts teacher_id and appends a WHERE clause when provided. Frontend: redesigned lesson-plans page with a searchable teacher dropdown at top (fetches GET /api/v1/teachers, debounced 300ms search). When no teacher is selected, the generate form + LP list are visually dimmed (opacity-40, pointer-events-none) and a message says select a teacher to get started. When a teacher is selected, a context banner shows Generating for: [Teacher Name] with a Change button; generate form passes X-Teacher-ID header; LP list fetches with teacher_id query param filtered to that teacher. Build passes 0 TS errors, 25/25 non-auth backend tests pass.
